boundary: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION ONLY. All market values, contract identifiers, source names, and effective dates are invented test inputs. evidence.name: Nearby spread
evidence.rationale: Widening earlier-minus-later settlement spread conditionally supports tighter nearby availability; same contract pair required.
evidence.reason: Observed change evaluated against UP expectation; absolute threshold 10 CNY/tonne.

evidence.name: Visible inventory
evidence.rationale: Falling covered stocks support the hypothesis only if source definition and coverage are comparable.
evidence.reason: Observed change evaluated against DOWN expectation; absolute threshold 1000 tonne.

evidence.name: Refined production
evidence.rationale: Higher domestic supply weakens this narrow supply-side mechanism, conditional on unchanged unobserved demand.
evidence.reason: Observed change evaluated against DOWN expectation; absolute threshold 10000 tonne.

evidence.name: Refined imports
evidence.rationale: Import changes may reflect demand, arbitrage, timing, or substitution; direction alone cannot classify physical tightness.
evidence.reason: Context only: this series has no unambiguous directional mapping.

evidence.name: Shipments
evidence.rationale: Optional contextual input; explicitly unavailable before local receipt, even if published earlier.
evidence.reason: No observations available at the cutoff.

alternative_explanations: Inventory moved between covered and uncovered locations rather than being consumed.
Publication lags and different observation frequencies obscure economic timing.
Contract-specific positioning or financing affected nearby spreads.
Customs revisions or reporting-definition changes altered comparable coverage.
Higher production coincided with stronger demand not measured by this fixture.
hypothesis.boundary: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION ONLY. All market values, contract identifiers, source names, and effective dates are invented test inputs. Evidence is conditional on the stated mechanism and source coverage. This does not establish actual China copper conditions, demand, causality, price forecasts, trading recommendations, or operational live-feed performance.
hypothesis.mechanism: A tighter nearby spread and falling visible inventory are modeled expectations of reduced readily deliverable supply. Rising domestic refined output can weaken that supply-side interpretation, all else equal. These are contestable associations, not identified causal effects.
hypothesis.question: Do the covered observations jointly support a hypothesis of tighter readily deliverable copper conditions in China?
